scope: Synthetic hardware prerequisite, not a model method or accuracy experiment
backend: existing torch cuSPARSELt default; no algorithm/threshold sweep
weight_generation: Synthetic random BF16 weights; native HiF4 QDQ then top2 per contiguous4 input weights, no learned values
activation_boundary: FP32 Smooth divide -> BF16 -> native HiF4 QDQ(force_fp32) -> BF16, full-width tanh GELU, original row-major output layout, biases and gate
correctness: Exact numeric sparse-weight decompression; separate FFN0/2 BF16 sparse-vs-dense-masked relative RMSE<=0.01. Complete-chain discrepancy reported separately; no native bitwise equivalence assumed.
timing: CUDA events, alternating arm order per repetition, resident weights, preprocessing/compression excluded and reported; sparse layout copies/padding inside timed forward
go_no_go: Only decide whether installed backend/shape merits future precision study. Report all timing samples; no candidate acceptance from this preflight.
resources: One idle controlled worker GPU; no model loads/downloads, no large tensor outputs; existing environment and original quantizer source unchanged
forbidden_inference: No Wan quality, original full160 FFN speed, real-weight2:4 accuracy, original UB1 identity or end-to-end speed claim
